question: Estimate the EBITDA margin for an Indian e-commerce platform like Meesho.
idealClarificationQuestions: Meesho core marketplace EBITDA margin? Yes.
FY26 (Meesho turned EBITDA positive in FY24)? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: PAT: still near break-even or slight loss.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: - Logistics (delivery cost subsidy + RTO + reverse logistics)

benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~1-5% (recently EBITDA positive after years of losses).

calculationFlow: - Logistics (delivery cost subsidy + RTO + reverse logistics): ~35-40% (Meesho's biggest cost; flat-rate shipping incl.).
- Marketing + customer acquisition: ~15-20% (down from 40%+ at peak burn).

finalAnswerRange.ideal: Net EBITDA margin: ~1-5% (recently EBITDA positive after years of losses).
